title: wanted to love it but it doesn't work - blades are VERY dull.
text:
wanted to love it but it doesn't work - blades are VERY dull.. Wanted to cut cucumber. Just mushed it.
Tried cutting cherry tomatoes. Mush.
Tried cutting spring onion. Got zigzag shaped "crimped" spring onion nicely accordion folded.
The blades are very dull but I can't fit it in my knife sharpener.
